author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I’m installing DITRA-HEAT cables into the mats using a grout float. This protects the cables and also keeps them slightly below the surface. Proper spacing is critical and I keep cables away from the wall, in-floor ductwork and toilet flanges per the instructions. Winter is coming soon and heated floors are always an awesome option
title: DITRA-HEAT Cable Tips - #schlutersystems #heatedfloor #sponsored
